protocol_type: Three-layer half-duplex contactless command/response protocol. Layer 2 (ISO 14443-2): 13.56 MHz carrier + modulation. Layer 3 (ISO 14443-3): anti-collision and selection. Layer 4 (ISO 14443-4): T=CL Block Transmission Protocol.

frame_types_type_a.name: Short frame
frame_types_type_a.purpose: Initial polling / wake / halt — no parity, no CRC.

frame_types_type_a.name: Standard frame
frame_types_type_a.used_for: SELECT, ATQA carry, SAK carry, RATS, ATS, T=CL blocks.

layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.name: REQA
layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.description: Request Command, Type A — wake any PICC in IDLE.

layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.name: WUPA
layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.description: Wake-Up Command, Type A — wake any PICC in IDLE or HALT.

layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.name: HLTA
layer3_short_frame_commands_type_a.description: HALT Command, Type A — instruct selected PICC to enter HALT state.

layer3_atqa_format.transmit_order: LSB byte 1 first then byte 2; bits LSB-first within each byte.

byte_1_bits.description: Which of the 5 anti-collision frame variants the PICC supports.
00 = single (4 B), 01 = double (7 B), 10 = triple (10 B), 11 = RFU.

common_values.interpretation: MIFARE Classic 1K or MIFARE Plus SL1 2K
MIFARE Classic 4K or MIFARE Plus SL1 4K
MIFARE DESFire (EV1/EV2/EV3) or MIFARE DESFire Light

layer3_select_cascade_commands_type_a.purpose: Anti-collision and SELECT for the 4 first bytes of UID.
Anti-collision and SELECT for UID bytes 4..7 (for 7- or 10-byte UID).
Anti-collision and SELECT for UID bytes 7..9 (for 10-byte UID).

well_known_values.meaning: MIFARE Classic 1K (and MIFARE Plus SL1 2K / SE).
ISO 14443-4 compliant — DESFire / Plus SL3 / JCOP.

layer3_anticollision_loop_summary: 3. PCD enters Cascade Level 1 (SEL = 0x93) — bit-frame anti-collision.
4. PCD sends SEL + NVB → PICCs reply UID-CL1[0..3] + BCC.
5. If bit collision at bit k: PCD records bits 0..k-1, sets bit k, updates NVB, retransmits.
6. Loop until NVB = 0x70 — only one PICC remains.
7. PCD sends full SELECT → PICC responds with SAK.
8. If SAK bit 3 = 1: advance to next Cascade Level.
9. After the final Cascade Level: PCD has complete UID + final SAK.
10. If SAK bit 6 = 1: PCD may issue RATS to activate Layer 4.

fields_command.name: PARAM
fields_command.description: FSDI 0..8 encodes PCD max frame size; CID 0..14.

layer4_block_format.block_number_field: PCB bit 1 is the 1-bit alternating block number.

crc_a_definition.covers: all frame bytes after SOF up to but excluding the CRC itself; CRC then appended LSB-first.

crc_b_definition.covers: all frame bytes after SOF up to but excluding the CRC.

msb_or_lsb_first: LSB-first on Type A wire; LSB-first on Type B wire; parity bit (Type A only) follows every byte.
valid_ready_handshake_rules: There is no VALID/READY handshake on the air interface; framing uses SOF + parity (Type A) or SOF + EGT (Type B) + CRC.
PCD-side flow control via Frame Waiting Time (FWT); if PICC needs longer, it transmits S(WTX).
Block-number alternation on T=CL detects lost block; R(NAK) requests retransmission.

frame_format.type_a_standard_frame: SOF + repeat[ byte LSB-first + odd parity bit ] + CRC_A + EOF.
frame_format.type_a_anti_collision: SOF + bytes-up-to-collision + collision bit + remaining bits from PICC + EOF.
frame_format.type_b_frame: SOF + char[ start(0) + 8 data + stop(1) + 2 EGT ETU HIGH ] + CRC_B + EOF.

channels.name: RF (air carrier)
channels.direction: PCD → field; PICC modulates load → PCD

command_set_layer_summary.layer_2_iso14443_2: Modulation + carrier; no commands at this layer.
command_set_layer_summary.layer_3_iso14443_3_type_a: REQA / WUPA / ATQA / ANTICOLLISION / SELECT / SAK / HLTA.
command_set_layer_summary.layer_4_iso14443_4: RATS / ATS / PPS / I-Block / R-Block / S(DESELECT) / S(WTX).
command_set_layer_summary.layer_application_mifare_classic: AUTH (0x60/0x61), READ (0x30), WRITE (0xA0), DECREMENT, INCREMENT, TRANSFER.
command_set_layer_summary.layer_application_mifare_desfire: AuthenticateAES (0xAA), SelectApplication (0x5A), ReadData (0xBD), WriteData (0x3D), GetVersion (0x60), GetUID (0x51).
